meta.name: Parinda
meta.description: Brothers Kishan and Karan grow up in Bombay. Karan soon leaves to study in America while Kishan enters into a life of crime, falling under the sway of Anna Seth, a drug lord. When Karan returns to Bombay,  Kishan intends to keep him as far away from his criminal life as possible, but things don't go as planned.
meta.slogan: The Most Powerful Film Ever Made
